title: Project categories via free-text column + shared grouping helper

ProgressBar (src/components/ui/ProgressBar.tsx) shows the open 'moving' snail by default and the closed-shell snail when paused=true. The closed shell should appear whenever timing is NOT actively running, not only on status==='paused'. Today passes paused={!isToday || timerState.status !== 'running'}; static editors (EditTimingsModal) pass paused unconditionally.

description: NSIS installer's Finish page hung/froze for a long time because runAfterFinish auto-launches the freshly installed unsigned exe while Windows Defender/SmartScreen scans it. Not app code. There is no in-app Finish button.
resolution: Set build.nsis.runAfterFinish=false in package.json so Finish closes immediately; user launches from the shortcut. Real fix for the delay is code-signing the installer.
